sources.title: clip-ViT-L-14: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview clip-ViT-L-14 is a vision-language model developed by sentence-transformers that maps both images and text to a shared 768-dimensional vector space, enabling direct comparison between visual and textual content. The model uses a Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture with a large patch size of 14 pixels, trained using contrastive learning on image-text pairs to align representations ...

sources.snippet: OpenAI's development of CLIP (Contrastive Language Image Pre-training) has seen a lot of development in multimodal and natural language models. CLIP VIT L14 shows how you can represent image and text processing tasks.
